$comment: Per-prop material restyle mapping for scripts/restyle.py against art/palette.json. Each prop lists its sourceMaterials first, then maps every material to a palette swatch and flatten strength (0..1: lower keeps printed labels/artwork/multi-part contrast; higher unifies plain plastic, wood, metal and scanned surfaces).

desk_lamp_arm_01.note: The lamp stays red: the warm accent on the imagination side, balancing the red mug on the other.

desk_lamp_arm_01_light.note: Lamp bulb glass; kept opaque with warm bulb emission so src/props.ts fitBulb() locates the bulb mesh and attaches the desk SpotLight.

portable_cassette_player.note: Walkman body shifts from neutral grey to the teal accent swatch; moderate flatten keeps printed lettering, tape label and dark buttons readable.

portable_cassette_player_glass.note: Clears the opaque JPEG window texture into translucent glass so the cassette tape inside the lid is visible.

stationery_supplies.note: Single shared atlas across cup, pencils, pens and eraser; gentle flatten warms stray neon hues towards mustard while preserving dark-cup vs light-pencil value separation.

round_spectacles.note: Thin round wire frames unified to dark-metal.

round_spectacles_glass.note: Drops opaque JPEG diffuse and dark vertex AO so lenses read as clear optical glass over the notebook.

rubber_duck_toy.note: Pulls hyper-saturated orange rubber into warm 1980s mustard while keeping darker beak and painted eyes legible.

Camera_01_body.note: 35mm SLR body in near-black; moderate flatten preserves shutter dial numerals and top-plate engravings.

Camera_01_lens.note: Untextured transmissive front lens element takes specular glass swatch over the dark inner barrel.

Camera_01_lens_body.note: Machined lens rings in dark-metal while keeping white aperture and focus-distance markings readable.

Camera_01_strap.note: Worn leather neck strap unified to near-black.

potted_plant_04.note: Pot, succulent leaves and soil share one atlas; low-moderate flatten warms the stark white pot to beige ceramic and mutes raw photographic leaf greens.

wall_clock.note: Removes cold blue steel cast from rim towards warm-grey plastic while keeping the cream dial and 1-12 numerals sharp.

wall_clock_glass.note: Clean clock cover glass without a separate 1k roughness map.

hanging_picture_frame_01.note: Turns cold black moulding into warm walnut wood matching the corkboard and diploma frames.

hanging_picture_frame_01_artwork.note: Warm cream-paper backing (replaced at runtime by reunionPrint() in src/props.ts).

hanging_picture_frame_01_glass.note: Replaces opaque black JPEG glass with clear glass.

Globe.003.note: Antique map sphere: a light touch, so the blue-green oceans and the continents keep their colour; matte paper roughness.

Globe_Base.note: Globe stand and meridian arc unified to aged brass per art/palette.json.

lambert1.note: Canon 310XL body in near-black plastic band while keeping the side Canon 310XL nameplate and exposure markings legible.

lambert5.note: Fixes metallic-1.0 dark lens and viewfinder meshes into clear specular optical glass.

sfmtelephone001rotary.note: Rescues the phone body, receiver and cord from metallic-1.0 black into warm 1980s Bell-style beige-plastic per art/palette.json.

sfmtelephone001rotary_rotary.note: Rotary dial wheel and number ring in contrasting warm-grey so finger holes and numerals stay readable.

Scene_-_Root.note: Untextured decimated skull scan takes matte cream-paper (sun-bleached bone) instead of raw dark brown.

material0.note: Flattens baked underside studio shadow and scan noise on the leather rugby ball into rich walnut leather while preserving seams and lacing.

defaultMat.note: Photogrammetry scan with deck, grip tape, trucks and wheels in one texture; moderate flatten removes lighting gradients and warms wood to walnut while keeping dark grip and light wheels.

Material.001.note: Main acrylic slate and clapsticks: removes wrong 0.88 metalness and keeps white PROD./ROLL/SCENE/TAKE lines and diagonal stripes crisp.

Material.002.note: Slate edge and stick trim matched to near-black.

Material.003.note: Clapper corner hinge bracket in dark-metal.

Material.004.note: Untextured hinge bolts/nuts take dark-metal instead of raw white metallic.

DefaultMaterial.note: Painted vintage toy biplane mapped to the tomato red accent swatch while keeping dark tires, struts and engine shading.

LMP0001_Textures.note: Tripod stand and softbox shroud unified to near-black; front diffuser emission warmed from clinical #ffffff to cream-paper.

computerchair_material.note: Bent-plywood office chair shifted from bright orange tan into warm walnut wood while preserving wood grain and base contrast.

vintage_suitcase_01.note: Stickered vintage suitcase: lower flatten turns the olive-grey body to warm walnut leather while keeping the travel stickers colorful and readable.

vintage_suitcase_02.note: Plain companion suitcase mapped to warm tan cork/suede leather.
